learning_outcomes.text: Able to create and analyze magnetic circuits.
Recognizes the structure of DC machines and knows their operating principles.
Knows the load characteristics of DC generators.
Knows the load characteristics of DC motors.
Performs efficiency, voltage regulation and power analysis using the equivalent circuit of 1-phase transformers.

syllabus_topics: General Principles and Definitions Related to Energy Conversion
Structure of Direct Current Machines, voltage and torque generation
Excitation method of Direct Current Machines
Electrical equivalent circuit models and characteristics of DC generators
Electrical equivalent circuit models and characteristics of DC motors
Starting, speed control and braking of DC motors
Examination of General Structures, Types and Operating Principles of Transformers
Derivation of Equivalent Circuits and Drawing of Phasor Diagrams of Single-Phase Transformers
No-load and short-circuit operation of Single-Phase Transformers
Parallel Operation of Two Single-Phase Transformers and Autotransformers
bibliography: Fundamentals of Electric Machines (Author: S. J. Chapman)
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
